name: Core Web Foundations
description: Why this matters: Strong platform fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JS/TS) make apps faster, more accessible, and significantly easier to maintain. We ground every build in platform-native best practices: type-safe JavaScript, accessible HTML, and modern CSS. This foundation enables maintainable codebases, reliable refactors, and fast, inclusive user experiences. Preferred defaults: TypeScript strict mode; UnoCSS or Tailwind; semantic HTML with ARIA and WCAG 2.2 targets.
